text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! This morning was amazing! 
You won't believe what happened when I 
woke up...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Whenever I sleep super soundly, 
this always happens.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
King-chan fixed it for me, but... It was 
so funny, I kinda wanted to show you.

...At any rate, a good night's sleep left 
her full of energy!
